m: वडभि or वड˚भी, f. = वलभि, ˚भी (q.v.), Hariv.; R.; Megh.
वडबा (आ), f., see next.
वडबा f. (also written वदवा, बडवा, बडबा) a female horse, mare, TS. &c. &c.
the nymph Aśvinī (who, in the form of a mare as wife of Vivasvat or the Sun, became the mother of the two Aśvins; cf. अश्विनी), Pur.; Daś.
a partic. constellation represented by a horse's head, W.
a female slave, L.
a harlot, prostitute, L.
= द्विज-स्त्री, L.
N. of a woman (having the patr. Prātītheyī), GṛS.
of a wife of Vasu-deva (called परिचारिका), Hariv.
of a river, MBh.
of a place of pilgrimage, Viṣṇ.
वडबा—भर्तृ m. ‘mare's husband’, N. of the mythical horse Uccaiḥ-śravas (q.v.), Śiś.
वडबा—भृत v.l. for -ह्रित (q.v.)

वडबा˚ग्नि m. (˚बाग्नि or ˚वाग्नि) ‘mare's fire’, submarine fire or the fire of the lower regions (fabled to emerge from a cavity called the ‘mare's mouth’ under the sea at the South pole; cf. और्व), MBh.; Kathās.
वडबा—˚ग्नि—मल n. a partic. foamy substance on the sea, L.
वडबा—हृत mfn. maid of a kind of slave, Yājñ., Sch.
वडबा—मुखी f. N. of a Yoginī, Hcat.
वडबा—मुख n. ‘mare's mouth’, N. of the entrance to the lower regions at the South Pole, Āryabh.; MBh.; Hariv.
वडबा—मुख m. (with or scil. अग्नि) = वडबाग्नि (also identified with Śiva or the Maharṣi Nārāyaṇa), ib.; R.; Kathās.
वडबा—मुख m. pl. N. of a mythical people, VarBṛS.; MārkP.
वडबा˚नल m. (˚बान्˚) = वडबाग्नि, Gol.; Kāv. (also personified, Vīrac.)
a partic. powder (prepared from pepper and other pungent substances to promote digestion), Bhpr.
वडबा—रथ m. a chariot drawn by mares, L.
वडबा—सुत m. du. ‘the two sons of Vaḍabā’, N. of the Aśvins, L.
वडबा—वक्त्र n. = -मुख n., MBh.
वडबा—वक्त्र—हुत-भुज् m. = वडबाल्ग्नि, Uttarar.
वडब m. (also written वडव, बडव, बडब) a male horse resembling a mare (and therefore attracting the stallion), Vait.
वडब—धेनु f. a mare, KātyŚr.
वडबिन् mfn. (fr. वडबा) g. व्रीह्य्-आदि.
वडहंसिका or वडहं˚सी, f. (in music) a partic. Rāgiṇī, Saṃgīt.

a: वडवा — 1 A mare. --2 The nymph Aśvinī who in the form of a mare bore to the sun two sons, the Aśvins; see संज्ञा. --3 A female slave. --4 A harlot, prostitute. --5 A woman of the Brāhmaṇa caste ( द्विजयोषित्). --Comp. --अग्निः, --अनलः the submarine fire. --मुखः {1} the submarine fire. {2} N. of Śiva.
